title: Massive Powiatdle facts enrichment and regional geographic intelligence
body:
POWIATDLE FACTS & KB ENRICHMENT
- Enriched Polish counties (Powiatdle) with 7 new verified knowledge relations: 23 National Parks, major lakes, 17 UNESCO World Heritage sites, 45 statutory health resorts (uzdrowiska), historical partitions (zabory) & Ziemie Odzyskane, historical regions (krainy historyczne), and Baltic Sea coastline access.
- Added enriched relations for major motorways and expressways (A1, A2, A4, S3, S7, S8).
- Refined Polish grammar in border and plate explanations.

WOJEWÓDZTWA GEOGRAPHIC INTELLIGENCE
- Added relative cardinal directions (północ, południe, wschód, zachód) and voivodeship genitive alias resolution for Województwodle.
